_meta.patch_note: Régression v3.5→v3.6 corrigée : chives (carbs/fat/fiber), date (carbs/sugar/fiber/protein), mango/green_mango/watermelon (fractions lipidiques)

v3.0: All fields now mandatory (null when unknown, never omitted)
Added scientific_name to _meta and variant level
v3.1: auto_correct_v6 : enrichissement champs étendus (30 champs sources)
Ajout : starch_g, alcohol_g, iodine_ug, choline_mg depuis sources
Ajout : scientific_name depuis CIQUAL via ontology_v6
v3.5: Fix: sat>fat contamination (flour×6: almond/oat/rye/spelt/teff/wheat) — FA recalculées depuis ratio USDA
Fix: FA>fat violations (yogurt×2, maple_syrup, sauce×5, pastry/samosa, pea_protein)
Fix: sugar>carbs cap (milk_plant×3, bell_pepper, hemp_milk, citrus/orange, cabbage/red, watermelon, curry, butter)
Fix: starch>carbs (arugula, salt, tofu, wasabi, milk_plant/soy, paneer)
Fix: chives/default — macros dried-form contamination → USDA #11216 fresh (carbs 38.1→1.85, fat 3.5→0.73, fiber 26.2→2.50)
Fix: date/default — carbs severely underestimated → USDA Medjool (carbs 31.3→68.27, sugar 31.3→66.5, fiber 3.6→6.7)
Fix: salt GI corrected to 0 (pure NaCl, no starch)
Fix: potato starch corrected (15.8→14.58) to satisfy starch≤carbs-sugar constraint
v3.2: FIX: lait/crème végétal liquide → starch_g = 0 (règle biologique)
FIX: flour[almond] fat_g corrigé (~2g → ~49g, valeurs USDA #2261756)
FIX: starch+sugar > carbs → starch recalculé par cohérence
ADD: flour variants → base_ingredient (résolution sémantique IA)
ADD: health_score v2 — formule documentée NutriScore+FSA, recalculé sur tous variants
ADD: validation_score (0-1) + errors_detected + warnings_detected sur 422 variants
v3.6: 4d. lipid_scaling : sat/mono/poly scalés proportionnellement vers fat_g
→ scale = fat_g / (sat+mono+poly) quand delta > 1 g et sub > 0
4e. omega_cap    : omega3+omega6 capés à poly_g (omega ⊂ PUFA)
→ rescale proportionnel si poly>0, zeroing si poly=0
v3.7: auto_correct_v6.3 : data truth — source priority + sanity checks
AJOUT : SOURCE_PRIORITY + KNOWN_LIPID_PROFILES (valeurs mesurees, priorite absolue)
AJOUT : FAT_SANITY guard — fat_g rejete si >5x sub_total existants
AJOUT : 4e omega_cap biologique — cap sans scaling (omega dans PUFA)
v4.0: Schema v4.0 : 6 nouveaux blocs derives des donnees sources
AJOUT : nutrition_flags (labels EU 1924/2006 : high_fiber, good_source_iron, low_sodium...)
AJOUT : reco_context (energy_density, satiety_score, micronutrient_richness, omega ratios)
AJOUT : substitution (same_category auto + alternatives curatedees veg/vegan)
AJOUT : data_field_type sur toutes les variantes
